fusions.name: Raking Tangle
fusions.desc: Turns up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles against each other for 5 seconds, dealing 8 damage to each and knocking each back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Furrowing Drag
fusions.desc: Drags a link across the target, dealing 9 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Leavings Heap
fusions.desc: Heaps a rampart 5 tiles long ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Gleanings
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 2 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
